description: Multi-turn conversations (Phase 5) to compare the agent (session memory, question rewriting) with direct access (each question on its own). Follow-up turns refer to earlier ones (pronouns, 'there', 'that club'...), so they need the conversation to be understood. 'answer' is a short span looked for in the generated answer (normalised, like contains_answer). Facts come from the indexed corpora (CV biography, XQuAD, vLLM docs).
